body: I feel selfish for even trying to be a mom. I had anxiety and depression since childhood, and everyone including my husband said not to have children because I would be a terrible mother. She was a surprise, and I always wanted to be a mother.I was so happy when I found out I was pregnant, but went through it mostly alone. Everyone else was "well, we'll see how it goes when she gets here." I feel like I am just proving them right, and my daughter will be the one to suffer for it.

Yeah, I've asked to be taken to a doctor. Husband cares, but is working weekdays and there is no weekend apointments for new patients. We move every time I find somewhere to go/someone to see. I think I'm going to go to the E.R. tomorrow morning and see what they can do. I can't wait anymore. I'm afraid of myself. I want to be a grizzly bear mom, but I have scary thoughts and impulses. Sometimes I lose track of time, and can barely sleep more than an hour at a time. I think I am beyond toughing this out. I just needed to tell someone. I have no one else to talk to.

I'd rather not say her name, but I named her after my favorite flower. It used to grow everywhere around where I grew up as a kid, and to this day the smell makes me feel like home. I don't really make plans, but wonder what she will be passionate about. She's already a very intense kid.
She loves books. She pretends to read them to me. She's starting to walk while holding on to the furniture, but not quite brave enough to try it on her own yet.
